entities.name: High Marshal Arguel
entities.description: A vampire knight from Torrezon who discovered the Temple of Aclazotz and died of his blood fast.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of the jungles and the temple.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: A lost temple of the bat-god in Ixalan's jungles.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The bat-god of night, eternal enemy of the Threefold Sun, imprisoned in Ixalan's core.

entities.name: Hierophant's Chalice
entities.description: An artifact that could provide endless blood once a drop of blood is added.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire order whose golden armor Arguel wore.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: The first to enter the temple after Arguel; enthralled by Zotz.

entities.name: Zotz
entities.description: A demon-spawn of Aclazotz who laired in the temple.

entities.name: Alante
entities.description: A cleric of the Order of the Five Sacraments who led the party that killed Zotz.

entities.name: Order of the Five Sacraments
entities.description: Alante's order, which kept the Chalice.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: Leader of the Church of Dusk who later frees Aclazotz.

events.summary: Arguel's blood fast visions lead him into Ixalan's jungle to the lost Temple of Aclazotz.
events.quote: Arguel walked through the blood and into the grand structure, but the bat god was not there.

events.summary: Arguel dies inside the temple, chalice in hand, his blood fast never ended.
Mavren Fein enters the temple and falls under the enslavement of Zotz.
events.quote: Mavren then fell under the enslavement of Zotz

events.summary: Alante's party battles Mavren and Zotz; Zotz is killed, freeing Mavren from his hold.
events.quote: When Zotz was killed, its death finally broke its hold on Mavren

events.summary: Alante finds Arguel's corpse and claims the Hierophant's Chalice for the Order of the Five Sacraments.
events.quote: Alante claimed the Hierophant's Chalice from Arguel's corpse

relations.quote: the Order of the Five Sacraments cleric Alante
her sworn enemy, Vona de Iedo
